description: Single-panel linear-regression plot, labelled (b), of mass density against element content. The y-axis reads "ρ, Mass density (g/cm³)" spanning 6.0 to 7.0 with 0.2 divisions; the x-axis reads "Element content (mass%)" from 0 to 40 with major ticks every 10. A legend at the upper right identifies three series: open grey stars = Al%, solid blue circles = Mn%, open red squares = 10×C%. Each series carries a straight-line fit. The black Al% line has by far the steepest negative slope, falling from about 6.9 g/cm³ near 6 mass% Al down to 6.0 g/cm³ at roughly 17 mass%. The blue Mn% line is the shallowest, descending from a little under 6.9 g/cm³ at x = 0 to about 6.5 g/cm³ at x = 40. The red 10×C% line runs from about 6.7 g/cm³ at x = 0 to about 6.3 g/cm³ at x = 40. Experimental points cluster as stars between roughly 6 and 14 mass% Al, red squares between roughly 8 and 14 on the 10×C% scale, and blue circles at approximately 18, 22, 26, 30 and 34 mass% Mn. A boxed equation is printed inside the plot: ρ = 8.1−0.102C%−0.1Al%−0.01Mn%. The panel demonstrates that, per unit mass percent added, Al lowers the mass density of these Fe–Mn–Al–C low-density steels much more strongly than C, and Mn only weakly.

observations.observation: The panel is labelled (b) and plots mass density ρ (g/cm³, axis 6.0-7.0) against element content (mass%, axis 0-40), implying a companion panel (a) exists outside this crop.
Legend entries are printed exactly as: open star = Al%, solid blue circle = Mn%, open red square = 10×C%.
A boxed equation inside the plot reads ρ = 8.1−0.102C%−0.1Al%−0.01Mn%.
The Al% (black) fit line is the steepest, running from about 6.9 g/cm³ near 6 mass% down to 6.0 g/cm³ at roughly 17 mass%.
The Mn% (blue) fit line is the shallowest of the three, starting just under 6.9 g/cm³ at 0 mass% and ending near 6.5 g/cm³ at 40 mass%.
The 10×C% (red) fit line is intermediate in slope, running from about 6.7 g/cm³ at 0 to about 6.3 g/cm³ at 40 on the 10×C% axis.
Blue circle data points for Mn% are plotted at roughly 18, 22, 26, 30 and 34 mass%, with densities between about 6.5 and 6.7 g/cm³.
Red square points (10×C%) cluster between about 8 and 14 on the x-axis at densities between roughly 6.55 and 6.7 g/cm³.
Because C is plotted as 10×C%, the plotted red line slope of about −0.01 g/cm³ per plotted unit corresponds to the −0.102 coefficient for C (mass%) in the printed equation.
The ranking of density-lowering potency per mass% shown in the panel is Al (black, steepest) > C (red, as 10×C%) > Mn (blue, shallowest), consistent with the printed coefficients 0.1, 0.102 and 0.01.
The supplied caption text is only '7.0', which matches the top y-axis tick value and does not describe the panel; no descriptive caption content is available for this figure.
